shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.html ---\\n' && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 version --json | tail -20 && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 peerDependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/DatePicker/hooks/datePickerStateFactory.d.ts && printf '\\n--- picker state ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/datePicker.d.ts && printf '\\n--- input types ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/inputs.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -40 && rg -n \"loadLocale\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | head -50"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx package.json package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -300'
/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -type f -delete && find dist -depth -type d -empty -delete && git status --short'
